name: Technical Stage Production Internship (Apollo Theater Academy)
what_you_do: A paid summer internship with the Apollo production crew. You work on lighting, sound, video, building sets and stage design. You help put on the summer Apollo Teen Takeover event.
who_can_apply: Rising seniors going into 12th grade in September who live in the five boroughs of New York City. You like technical theater. You must come to the full program and a parent or guardian orientation.
duration: 6 weeks, Monday to Friday, on site. The 2026 program ran July 13 to Aug 21, 2026.
deadline_text: The 2026 application closed June 26, 2026. Interviews were June 30 and July 1. The 2027 dates are not posted.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online application on Formstack before the deadline. The page says group interviews happen by appointment. Accepted teens and a parent or guardian go to an orientation on the first day.
notes: The Apollo Arts Administration internship page says interns under 18 must show New York State working papers. This technical internship page does not say so. Expect to need them for a paid job.
